title.value: Multistep networks for roll force prediction in hot strip rolling mill
title.justification: The paper primarily focuses on developing a multistep network system to predict roll force in hot strip rolling mills, as indicated by the title.
title.quote: Multistep networks for roll force prediction in hot strip rolling mill

extractions.description: The paper presents a machine learning-based framework to predict roll forces at hot strip rolling mills, addressing the limitations of current models by using individual models for each rolling stand and considering rolling history. This enhances the prediction accuracy and stability significantly over traditional methods.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The paper primarily discusses a technique for improving industrial processes in steel production. While there may be indirect links to sustainability, such as improved efficiency and resource use, sustainable development is not the central theme of this paper.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: In this paper, we propose a machine learning based framework to establish a model that accurately predicts roll forces at each mill stands of the hot strip rolling mill.

primary_category.justification: The paper does not primarily focus on Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development. Its main objective is improving industrial operations in the steel manufacturing process.
primary_category.quote: The enhanced prediction accuracy will greatly improve dimensional and microstructural control, as well as ensuring the avoidance of mill overloads.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper does not address any secondary climate or ecological sustainable development areas. It remains focused on industrial process improvements.
secondary_categories.quote: Hot rolling is a key process step where a number of rolling stands (aka passes) reduce the thickness of hot steel slab via exerting tremendous roll forces.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not fit into any of the predefined sub-categories related to Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development. It is focused on rolling mill operation improvements.
primary_sub_category.quote: In this paper, to provide more stable and accurate roll force predictions, we propose an expert machine learning based system that considers an individual model for each rolling stand.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: No information in the paper supports relevance to any secondary sub-categories under Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: Neural networks were also adopted in more recent studies attempting to predict numerous strip properties in hot rolling process.

applications.value: Improved roll force prediction in steel production
applications.justification: The paper's main application is in enhancing the predictive accuracy of roll forces in hot strip rolling mills which is an operational improvement, potentially reducing resource waste and energy use.
applications.quote: The enhanced prediction accuracy will greatly improve dimensional and microstructural control, as well as ensuring the avoidance of mill overloads.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper is centered on optimizing the prediction of roll forces in steel rolling mills using machine learning, which improves industrial process efficiency.
new_primary_category.quote: In this paper, we propose a machine learning based framework to establish a model that accurately predicts roll forces at each mill stands of the hot strip rolling mill.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The content specifically deals with improvements in steel manufacturing via machine learning to predict processes more accurately.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: Hot rolling processes consist of multiple single rolling stand operating at high temperature and speed to achieve desired steel shapes and superior properties, via exerting roll forces that need to be accurately predicted by a model.
